ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-dominance of low-intensity (black/dark-blue) pixels with approximately <5% high-intensity (white/tan) pixels localized to specific focal points and distal edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity field across both lobes; distinct high-contrast white circular pixel clusters on the mid-left lobe; dense tan/white geometric clusters localized at the left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an interior angle of approximately 45-50 degrees; depth is moderate relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; extreme jagged topography at the distal tips due to biological colonization; prominent U-shaped indentations visible on the upper left margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upper margins transitioning into sharp, irregular distal points; lower margins appear slightly concave toward the peduncle insertion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of 4 to 5 distinct white annular pixel clusters (circular scars) located on the medial-left lobe; dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast barnacle structures at the distal ends of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single vertical white linear pixel disruption approximately 15 pixels in length located superior to the circular scar cluster on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) creating significant physical profile alteration at both distal tips; circular scarring indicative of previous parasitic attachment on the ventral surface of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique spatial arrangement of ring-shaped white marks on the left lobe pigmentation.
